# `cortical_band`

a recording's band read on the cortex through the inverse kernel with the spatial band folded in, a pointwise complex field cortex x bands x time.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run cortical_band --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run cortical_band --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run cortical_band --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --bands "frequency bands" --spatial-scale "wavelength 40 mm" --all
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$kernel", "params.inverse.measure": "$method"} | yes |
| `z` | field analytic signal, chain band_analytic, chain_parameters {"recording": "{recording}", "band": "$band", "bands": "$bands", "shape": "$shape", "halo": "$halo"} (composed in: the recording's analytic signal in the band set (one transform a block shared by all bands)) | yes |
| `grid` | selection ladder, manifold kernel.to, when $spatial_scale (the surface's grid, whose level the spatial scale is (`nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface` first); absent when there is no spatial scale) | yes |
| `glued` | manifold surface, where {"name": "$glued_surface"}, required false (the glued cortex made by `nxr-neuro run glue`, by name: the field is made on it and restored to the original hemispheres for storage) | no |
| `canonical` | field canonical frames, manifold kernel.to, required false (a free-orientation kernel's tensor is read in the canonical frames (`nxr-neuro run surface_frames` first)) | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `kernel` | `--kernel` | `none` | - |  | the inverse kernel's name, or none: found by `method` |
| `method` | `--method` | `MNE` | - |  | the kernel's inverse method (its params.inverse.measure) |
| `bands` | `--bands` | none | - |  | the temporal band SET, by name (a member per band). Exactly one of band, bands |
| `band` | `--band` | none | Hz |  | ONE temporal band as a quantity ("8-16 Hz"). Exactly one of band, bands |
| `glued_surface` | `--glued-surface` | none | - |  | the glued cortex (the derived manifold made by `glue`) by name; null: the surface of record, no bridge |
| `shape` | `--shape` | `morlet` | - | morlet, power_partition | the temporal band's shape: morlet \| power_partition (nxr's bank: the band powers add to broadband) |
| `spatial_shape` | `--spatial-shape` | `mexhat` | - | mexhat, meyer | the spatial band's gain: mexhat \| meyer (the scale IS its Weyl band: compact edges) |
| `spatial_scale` | `--spatial-scale` | none | mm |  | the spatial band as a quantity: a tile diameter (20 mm), a wavelength (wavelength 40 mm), an eigenvalue (eigenvalue 1/m2) or a named scale; resolved to the grid's level by space_level_of_band; null: no spatial band (the kernel as it is) |
| `transform` | `--transform` | `auto` | - | auto, eigen, chebyshev, exact | the spatial band's route: auto (eigenmodes first, made when absent, said; chebyshev the announced fallback) \| eigen \| chebyshev \| exact |
| `envelope` | `--envelope` | `temporal` | - | temporal, spatiotemporal | temporal = \|z\| of the band-passed field \| spatiotemporal = the monogenic amplitude (another recipe: a rerun of the other envelope needs --replace) |
| `form` | `--form` | `none` | - | none, curl_tan, div_tan, normal | the pointwise form read on the field: none (the complex field) \| curl_tan (the tangential curl, for vortex cores) \| div_tan \| normal |
| `modes` | `--modes` | `0` | modes |  | when the eigenmodes are made: the package's size; 0: the standard 3000, or more when the scale needs it |
| `order` | `--order` | `0` | degree |  | chebyshev degree; 0: the smallest of 40 to 5120 within `tolerance` of the band's gain |
| `tolerance` | `--tolerance` | `0.01` | fraction |  | the largest difference between the band's gain and the chebyshev series that is accepted |
| `halo` | `--halo` | `8.0` | s |  | the context read on each side of a chunk for the filter |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`meeg.apply_kernel`](../nodes.md) | x=z, kernel=kernel, tiles=grid, glued=glued | spatial_scale=$spatial_scale, transform=$transform, modes=$modes, order=$order, tolerance=$tolerance, spatial_shape=$spatial_shape, envelope=$envelope, form=$form | sources |
| chunks over `recording` | [`meeg.apply_kernel`](../nodes.md) | x=z, kernel=kernel, glued=glued | transform=$transform, modes=$modes, order=$order, tolerance=$tolerance, spatial_shape=$spatial_shape, envelope=$envelope, form=$form | sources |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `sources` | kind field, kind_name source estimate, name {recording} x {kernel} bands, on kernel.to, derived_from recording, by_operator kernel |

## Notes from the definition

```text
A FIELD CHAIN (`kind: chain`): the recording's band read on the CORTEX through the inverse kernel, with the SPATIAL band folded into the kernel once (M = (F (x) I) K in preparation: a linear map reads the chain before
any non-linear step, D106). ONE pointwise field, no reduction and no detection: the field `cortex x members(bands) x T` (or x frames of a frame grid), complex, vector3 for a free kernel or scalar for a fixed one.
Run alone it stores the field; composed into `measure` (input `chain: cortical_band`) its steps are inlined, nothing stored, its provenance in the consumer's cache key.

THE GRAPH:  recording -- band_analytic (composed) -- apply_kernel {spatial_scale} --> field<cortex x members(bands) x T; complex>
The kernel's surface is the caller's: the two-hemisphere surface of record, or the glued surface made by `glue` (the default computational manifold for spatiotemporal patterns) named as the kernel's
target; results are restricted back to the original hemispheres for storage, export and figures.

TRANSFORM ROUTE. `auto` (the stored eigenmodes first; made, with a message, when absent; Chebyshev the announced fallback) | `eigen` | `chebyshev` | `exact` (dense, at most 4096 vertices).
ENVELOPE. `temporal` = |z| of the band-passed field (signed lobes: |z| dips to 0 where lobes of opposite sign meet) | `spatiotemporal` = the monogenic amplitude sqrt(|z|^2 + |R z|^2), R the band's Riesz part.

What it cannot resolve: the minimum-norm current is smooth (its spatial resolution is the kernel's point-spread, not the grid's); a free kernel's principal axis is partly its own prior.

  nxr-neuro run cortical_band --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --bands "frequency bands" --spatial-scale "wavelength 40 mm" --all
```
